title: [GMCP 203.012.06] Operations and evidence: Subscriptions, notifications, progress, and operational messages
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-012-06. Ship inspectable CLI, TUI or API state, configuration validation, bounded metrics/logs/traces, diagnostics, examples, migration and rollback guidance, incident runbooks, and reproducible evidence artifacts. Automate drift detection so a changed dependency or standard invalidates stale proof. Vector outcome: Modern subscriptions/listen filters and acknowledgement metadata work for tools, prompts, resources and resource updates, with bounded fan-out, ordering guarantees, cancellation, reconnect policy, backpressure and authorization re-checks. Progress and operational log notifications correlate to the originating request, obey requested levels and redaction, and never become an unbounded covert channel. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
